author: Brandy Betz
title: Munich court tells Apple to retract statement (update) - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
A Munich court orders Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) to pull part of its statement related to its iPhone injunction saying the statement was "misleading" regarding iPhone availability.
Source: Bloomberg First Word headlines. More information when available.
After the injunction, Apple said its iPhone 7 and 8 models from German retail stores but the newer models would remain on sale.
Update with the full story from Bloomberg :
Apple was ordered to pull the part of the release that said all iPhones would still be available in Germany through carriers and resellers when those sales were also included in the injunction.
